card.name: Patient stories from kids and families
card.fires_on: Words in patient-advocacy and personal story pages that refer to people living with a chronic illness, such as 'kids', 'parent', 'living' or the age number after 'age'. It also fires on the space or digits of a child's age in a story byline.

modes.label: Child age in bylines
modes.description: The space or digit after 'age' in a short named quote from a child or teen.

modes.label: People living with a condition
modes.description: Words like kids, PH, living or parent that name who has a chronic disease in advocacy text.

card.writes: It leans toward condition and disability words such as epilepsy, grief and disabled, and away from unrelated terms.
